name: On-chain demand + ADX trend strength — active-address cross-up gates a confirmed-trend BTC/ETH long
rationale: Thesis: a directional trend that is BOTH technically strong (high ADX) AND backed by accelerating on-chain demand (active-address cross_up) should continue. ADX is BOUNDED so a fitted floor binds and isolates 'a real trend exists'; btc_active_addresses drifts so it enters ONLY as a cross_up confirming fresh demand. The two are orthogonal in principle (one is price-derived trend strength, the other is network usage). Disconfirmer 1: keep only ADX>adx_floor and drop the address cross_up — if the deflated Sharpe holds, the on-chain leg is decorative. Disconfirmer 2: ADX has no direction, so without a positive-return check ADX could fire on strong downtrends; we add ret_Nd>0 as a direction gate, and if that single gate plus ADX explains the Sharpe (address cross permuted-lagged makes no difference), the on-chain confirmation is spurious. BTC/ETH, long-only spot.
catalyst: btc_active_addresses crosses up while ADX shows a strong, positively-directed trend
